selection: 54 new configurations plus the cached baseline. Rank by pooled inner correct count, macro-F1, then fixed order. Primary includes baseline; secondary new-only and language-only policies are fixed before outer scoring. No questionnaire items, gender, IDs, split labels or held-out targets are predictors.
preprocessing: Fit StandardScaler/PCA32 to original semantic-AV fitting rows only; append separately standardized fixed age and/or language features, scaled by the declared block weight. Age is recorded metadata, never inferred. All medians, scales, PCA and class weights use fitting participants only.
evaluation: Same 163 training participants, 5 outer folds, 3 inner folds and seeds 42/137/2026 as 49.08%. Reused exploratory population, not independent confirmation. Final model choice uses pooled inner predictions only. Official validation is scored only after freezing; test is not scored.
